+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+from _pytest.compat import get_default_arg_names
+
+
+# groundwork: allow-duplicate aggregates a name-keyed mapping via the existing helper
+def default_manifest(
+    functions: Iterable[Callable[..., object]],
+) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Map callable names to their keyword-addressable default parameters."""
+    manifest: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for function in functions:
+        defaults = get_default_arg_names(function)
+        name = getattr(function, "__name__", type(function).__name__)
+        manifest[name] = list(defaults)
+    return manifest

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from functools import partial
+from functools import wraps
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+from _pytest.default_manifest import default_manifest
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_default_manifest() -> None:
+    def mixed(
+        positional_only: int = 0,
+        /,
+        positional_or_keyword: int = 1,
+        *args: object,
+        required: int,
+        z: None = None,
+        a: int = 0,
+        **kwargs: object,
+    ) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    @wraps(mixed)
+    def wrapped() -> None:
+        pass
+
+    assert default_manifest(iter((wrapped, len, partial(mixed)))) == {
+        "mixed": ["positional_or_keyword", "z", "a"],
+        "len": [],
+        "partial": ["positional_or_keyword", "z", "a"],
+    }
+    assert default_manifest([]) == {}
+
+
+def test_invalid_signature_raises() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="__signature__"):
+        default_manifest([Mock(__signature__=object())])
